City Council Regular Meeting Agenda – June 21, 2022
  1
   City Council Regular Meeting Agenda
  Tuesday, June 21, 2022

   CALL TO ORDER
   PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE LED BY: Council Member Rivera
   ROLL CALL: Mayor Ding, Vice Mayor Harrington, Council Members Menchaca,
  Rivera, Wu

 1. APPROVAL OF AGENDA ORDER

 2. PRESENTATIONS – None.

 3. PUBLIC COMMENT

 4. CONSENT CALENDAR

  All items listed under the Consent Calendar are considered routine and
  recommendations will be approved in one motion unless a member of the
  City Council or audience requests separate discussion.

  A. RESOLUTION NO. 22-42 REAUTHORIZING THE CITY COUNCIL AND THE
  CITY’S COMMISSIONS TO IMPLEMENT TELECONFERENCE ACCESSIBILITY
  FOR CONDUCTING PUBLIC MEETINGS PURSUANT TO ASSEMBLY BILL 361

  Resolution No. 22-42 makes findings that allow the City to continue
  implementation of teleconference/internet-based accessibility for public
  meetings under state-of-emergency provisions.

  Recommended Action:

  Staff recommends that the City Council adopt Resolution No. 22-42 regarding
  the use of teleconferencing for public meetings.

  B. APPROVAL OF MINUTES

  The minutes are a record of the official actions taken at the City Council
  meeting.

  1. Minutes of the City Council Special Meeting of June 6, 2022.
  2. Minutes of the City Council Special Meeting of June 7, 2022.
  3. Minutes of the City Council Regular Meeting of June 7, 2022.

City Council Regular Meeting Agenda – June 21, 2022  2
   Recommended Action: Approval.

  C. MATERIAL DEMANDS

  The most recent Material Demands from the Finance Department are presented
  to the City Council for review and approval.

  Recommended Action:

  Staff recommends that the City Council approve Material Demands as
  presented.

  D. CASH AND INVESTMENT REPORT – MAY 2022

  In accordance with the City of San Gabriel’s 2021-22 Adopted Investment Policy
  (Resolution No. 21-30 dated July 20, 2021) and California Government Code
  Section 53646, the Finance Director is to render an investment report to the
  City Council, City Treasurer, City Manager, and the City Attorney. The May 2022
  Cash and Investment Report is presented to receive and file in accordance with
  the City’s adopted 2021-22 Investment Policy.

  Recommended Action:

  Staff recommends that the City Council receive and file the Cash and
  Investment Report for May 2022.

  E. MONTHLY BUDGET UPDATE – MAY 2022

  This staff report provides the monthly budget update for the City’s General
  Fund and Mission Playhouse as of May 31, 2022. The monthly budget
  incorporates the actual revenue received and expenditures that have occurred
  through May 31, 2022, and projects the financial results for the year ending on
  June 30, 2022.

  Recommended Action:

  Staff recommends that the City Council receive and file the report.

  F. AGREEMENT FOR USE OF SMITH PARK POOL BY MID VALLEY WATER
  POLO

City Council Regular Meeting Agenda – June 21, 2022  3
   Mid Valley Water Polo has used Smith Park Pool since October 2020 for their
  regular water polo team practices. On June 30, 2022, the Agreement between
  the City of San Gabriel and Mid Valley Water Polo for the use of Smith Park
  Pool will expire.

  Recommended Action:

  Staff recommends that the City Council approve the Agreement for Mid Valley
  Water Polo’s use of Smith Park Pool to be effective July 1, 2022, and authorize
  the City Manager to execute the agreement.

  G. AGREEMENT FOR USE OF SMITH PARK POOL BY SAN GABRIEL SEA GULLS

  The San Gabriel Sea Gulls (SGSG) use Smith Park pool for their regular swim
  team use and uses the pool throughout the year for its swim team practices
  and swim meets. On July 30, 2022 the Agreement between the City of San
  Gabriel and the San Gabriel Sea Gulls for the use of Smith Park Pool will expire.

  Recommended Action:

  Staff recommends that the City Council approve the Agreement for San Gabriel
  Sea Gulls use of Smith Park pool to be effective July 1, 2022, and authorize the
  City Manager to execute the agreement.

  H. AGREEMENT FOR USE OF SMITH PARK POOL BY MONTEREY PARK
  MANTA RAYS

  The Monterey Park Manta Rays (MPMR) have begun use of Smith Park Pool for
  their regular swim team practice and practice outside of the San Gabriel Sea
  Gulls practice times. On June 30, 2022, the Agreement between the City of San
  Gabriel and Monterey Park Manta Rays will expire.

  Recommended Action:

  Staff recommends that the City Council approve the Agreement for Monterey
  Park Manta Rays use of Smith Park Pool to be effective July 1, 2022, and
  authorize the City manager to execute the agreement.

  I. AWARD CONSTRUCTION CONTRACT TO VASILJ, INCORPORATED FOR
  THE DEL MAR AVENUE SEWER REHABILITATION PROJECT CONTRACT NO.

City Council Regular Meeting Agenda – June 21, 2022  4
   22-03 (CAPITAL IMPROVEMENT PROJECT 4-14-01) IN THE AMOUNT NOT
  TO EXCEED $1,969,338

  The 2009 Sewer Master Plan identified $30 million in needed capacity upgrades
  and structural repairs to the City’s sanitary sewer system. The original Sewer
  Master Plan identified a need to increase the flow capacity of the sewer line
  along Del Mar Avenue between Bencamp Street and Lime Avenue. These sewer
  improvements are also required as part of the March 2016 Consent Judgment
  between the City and the Regional Water Quality Control Board. The City
  Council will consider an award of a construction contract for the Del Mar Sewer
  Rehabilitation Project from Bencamp Street to Lime Avenue to Vasilj, Inc. for an
  amount not to exceed $1,969,338. This project will replace the existing 12-inch
  sewer main with a new 15-inch sewer main. This award would also require
  adoption of a resolution to increase the previously-budgeted amount of
  $1,035,205.29. Sewer Funds of $1,035,205.29 are available in the approved
  Fiscal Year 2021-22 CIP 4-14-01 budget, and $934,132.71 of additional Sewer
  Funds shall be appropriated via Resolution No. 22-41 into the CIP 4-14-01
  budget account 122-800-38-97-728.

  Recommended Action:

  Staff recommends that the City Council:

  1. Adopt Resolution No. 22-41;
  2. Approve plans and specifications for the Del Mar Sewer Rehabilitation
  Project Contract No. 22-03 (CIP 4-14-01);
  3. Authorize the City Manager to execute a construction contract with Vasilj,
  Inc. for a total bid amount of $1,790,308; and
  4. Authorize the City Manager to approve a Purchase Order with Vasilj, Inc. for
  an amount not to exceed $1,969,338, which includes a 10% construction
  contingency.

  J. RESOLUTION NO. 22-39 APPROVING A REQUEST FOR TEMPORARY
  STREET CLOSURE ON THE 300 BLOCK OF BRIDGE STREET

  The Public Works Department received a request from Derek Mandee, resident
  at 324 Bridge Street, for a temporary street closure. The purpose of this request
  is to hold a block party which will be held on Sunday, July 3, 2022, on the 300
  block of Bridge Street between Sycamore Drive to the end of the cul-de-sac
  from 3:00 p.m. to 8:30 p.m.

  Recommended Action:

City Council Regular Meeting Agenda – June 21, 2022  5
   Staff recommends that the City Council adopt Resolution No. 22-39 authorizing
  closure on Bridge Street between Sycamore Drive to the end of the cul-de-sac
  from 3:00 p.m. to 8:30 p.m. on Sunday, July 3, 2022.

  K. FIFTH AMENDMENT TO PROFESSIONAL SERVICES AGREEMENT WITH RKA
  CONSULTING GROUP TO INCREASE THE CONTRACT AMOUNT BY $39,000
  FOR ADDITIONAL ENGINEERING SERVICES FOR THE WALNUT GROVE
  AVENUE AND BROADWAY INTERSECTION IMPROVEMENT PROJECT

  Due to COVID-19 impacts, a property ownership title change, additional
  coordination, valuation adjustments, and extended negotiations with the
  affected property owner for temporary construction easements, the existing
  contract with RKA Consulting Group needs to be amended to increase the
  scope of work for additional right-of-way acquisition services, to extend
  contract time, and to increase the contract amount by $39,000. Funding is
  available in the approved budget from Capital Improvement Project 1-08-11 in
  account 122-800-55- 97-706.

  Recommended Action:

  Staff recommends that the City Council:

  1. Authorize the City Manager to execute a Fifth Amendment of the
  Professional Service Agreement with RKA Consulting Group; and
  2. Authorize a Change Order that increases Purchase Order #8775 (a
  continuation of services previously covered by Purchase Order #6360 with
  an initial allocation of $22,071.20) by $39,000 from account #122-800-55-
  97-706 for a total Purchase Order amount of $61,071.20 for additional
  acquisition services.

 5. PUBLIC HEARING – None.

 6. CONTINUED BUSINESS – None.

 7. NEW BUSINESS – None.

 8. PUBLIC COMMENT

 9. CITY MANAGER’S REPORT

 10. COUNCIL COMMENTS AND CONFERENCE/MEETING REPORTS

City Council Regular Meeting Agenda – June 21, 2022  6
   Each Council Member may address the City Council and public on matters of
  general information and/or concern. This is also the time for Council Members to
  report on conferences and/or meetings they have attended.

  11. CLOSED SESSION – None.

  12. ADJOURNMENT

  The next regular City Council meeting will be held on Tuesday, July 19, 2022 at
  6:30 P.M. Information regarding matters to be considered at each meeting will be
  available on the Friday before the City Council Meeting on the City’s website at
  www.sangabrielcity.com.
